title: camp registry metrics sidecar
description: Upstream repository activity signals for one listed plugin, kept in metrics/<type>/<component>.yml beside its entry and written only by the registry's scheduled jobs (camp-index#522). Advisory data with a `checked` date; not a registry assertion.

updated.description: Upstream last-activity timestamp (GitHub pushed_at / GitLab last_activity_at). The maintenance-liveness signal.

open-issues.description: Open issues (on GitHub this also counts open pull requests, per the API).

archived.description: True when the maintainer has archived the source repository (upstream is frozen/dead).

ci.description: The repository's own CI runs this tool, detected from its workflow files (.github/workflows on GitHub, .gitlab-ci.yml on GitLab). An observed fact about the repository, not an author claim and not a registry assertion about the results; fetched for tier 1+ entries by `camp enrich`.

checked.description: Date these metrics were last fetched from the source platform.

latest-release.description: Upstream's newest published release (GitHub releases / GitLab releases), refreshed by `camp enrich`. Advisory display data — distinct from the registry's own verified release ledger.

latest-tag.description: Upstream's newest git tag by commit date (github.com sources, one GraphQL query), refreshed by `camp enrich`. Distinct from latest-release: many maintainers only tag, and a Release can trail the tags by years. Advisory display data, not a registry assertion (camp-tools#59).
